newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean economy grew 5.8 pct in July - Central Bank.
newsitem.headline: Chilean economy grew 5.8 pct in July - Central Bank.

text.p: The economy grew 5.8 percent in July, down from 6.3 percent in June, as measured by the Imacec index, the Central Bank reported.
The figure, compared to 7.5 percent growth in July 1995, was below most expectations and added to signs of slower growth in Chile starting in the second quarter.
Private forecasts for the July Imacec index had ranged up to seven percent.
The index is the Central Bank's main monthly indicator of economic activity and is considered a kind of early barometer of gross domestic product.
